# Local Evals

> Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local

results and an MCPJam identity

> [!NOTE]
>
> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam login or
`sk_` API key for every eval, including BYOK runs with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after the backend run-start endp
oint is deployed. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.\n\n`mcpjam test <file>` runs an MCPJam suite file locally: it con
nects your MCP servers, drives each case's prompts through a model, grades the transcript with the same assertions a hosted run us
es, and decides the run with the same verdict policy. Bring your own provider key and authenticate the run with MCPJam. With MCPJa
m-hosted inference it uses your existing CLI login and billing.\n\nResults are **never uploaded**. The command writes results to y
our terminal and, if you ask, to a report file. It records the run start with MCPJam. Like every command, it sends the CLI's singl
e anonymous [telemetry](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry.md) event, which `--no-telemetry` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` turns off; the

run adds no telemetry of its own.

## Eval identity and local data

Run `mcpjam cloud login` locally, or set `MCPJAM_API_KEY`
to an organization `sk_` key in CI. The SDK also accepts `apiKey` or `mcpjamAuth` in run options. Explicit credentials take prece
dence over `MCPJAM_API_KEY`, which takes precedence over the saved CLI login. An invalid explicit credential never falls back to a
nother account. CI never starts an interactive login. Ask an organization admin for a key if you cannot create one.\n\nEvery logic
al run needs an online start response. MCPJam retries transient failures within ten seconds, then stops before execution. A prior
successful run does not enable offline execution. The CLI resolves the project using its existing `--project`, environment, and li
nked-project settings; a key can only access its own organization.\n\nWith results uploads disabled, the start-run request sends o
nly the credential in the authorization header, any MCPJam API headers you configure through the SDK's `inference.resolveMcpjam`,
project selection, a new run-start ID, client version and surface (SDK, CLI, or Vitest), planned iteration count, provider names,
and whether a client profile is used (`unknown` for custom executors). The server resolves the organization and account. The start
-run request sends no prompts, outputs, tool calls, or server URLs. MCPJam-hosted inference still sends prompts through MCPJam to
the model, as before. Retries reuse the same ID. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage or a charge. This release adds
no debit, quota draw, or balance refusal.\n\n`DO_NOT_TRACK`, `MCPJAM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`, and CLI telemetry settings disable anal

ytics, not the required run-start request. Results remain local unless result uploading is enabled separately.

## Quick start

### 1. Write a suite

Save this as `.mcpjam/evals/example.yaml`:

```yaml theme={"theme":"css-variables"}
schemaVersion

: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
 id: s_notes_example
 name: Notes server
target:
 servers:

- name: notes
defaults:
 judge:
 enabled: false
 model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
 iterations: 1
 passThreshold:

1
 validity: {}
cases:
 - id: c_reads_a_note
 title: reads the note it was asked about
 steps:
 - id: s1

kind: prompt
 prompt: What does note 7 say?
 - id: a1
 kind: assert
 assertion:
 type:

toolCalledAtLeastOnce
 toolName: read_note
 - id: c_never_deletes
 title: never deletes when only asked to read

steps:
 - id: s1
 kind: prompt
 prompt: Summarize note 7.
 - id: a1
 kind: assert

assertion:
 type: toolNeverCalled
 toolName: delete_note
```

`mcpjam cloud eval validate --file .mcpjam/ev

als/example.yaml` checks the file offline, with no account.

### 2. Configure the server

`mcpjam test` binds each `target.ser
vers[].name` to a local MCP config. The simplest is a `.mcp.json` next to where you run the command:\n\n```json theme={\"theme\":\

e={"theme":"css-variables"}
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=[REDACTED]
mcpjam test .mcpjam/evals/example.yaml
```
